description: Source code for STM32F10x Power (PWR) peripheral firmware functions, including power management, low power modes, and register configurations.

methods.name: PWR_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the PWR peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: PWR_BackupAccessCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables access to the RTC and backup registers.

methods.name: PWR_PVDCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the Power Voltage Detector (PVD).

methods.name: PWR_PVDLevelConfig
methods.description: Configures the voltage threshold detected by the PVD.

methods.name: PWR_WakeUpPinCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the WakeUp Pin functionality.

methods.name: PWR_EnterSTOPMode
methods.description: Enters STOP mode with specified regulator state and entry method.

methods.name: PWR_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks whether a specified PWR flag is set.
